name: Draconic Avenger — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Draconic Avenger from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Draconic Avenger (Cavalier Archetype)" but are not part of the Draconic Avenger entry, which is unchanged.

While many cavaliers bond with noble horses, wolves, or camels, the draconic avenger earns the allegiance of a mighty drake, taking to land and sky side-by-side with a scion of dragons.

Class Features
Drake companion (Ex)

A draconic avenger gains a drake companion instead of a normal mount. The drake gains the glide drake power (air drakes instead gain the mount drake power, even if they would not normally qualify). The drake begins play at Small size rather than Tiny, modifying its baseline statistics for its new size. The drake companion does not increase in size at 17th level. In addition, the cavalier gains Mounted Combat as a bonus feat. For all class features, the drake companion is treated as a cavalier’s mount.

This ability replaces mount, iron steed, and steed’s parry.
